biographical_milestones.event: Annus Mirabilis Papers Published (Photoelectric Effect & Relativity)
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Revolutionized theoretical physics from Swiss patent office.
Officially awarded 1921 Nobel Prize for photoelectric law.

biographical_milestones.event: Permanent Emigration to Princeton, United States
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Relocated permanently to USA fleeing rising Nazi persecution in Germany.
Passed away at Princeton Hospital after refusing surgery.
